method: Selective reread of official pages through the web tool; no vendor application benchmark.
inherited_audit: source-audit.json retains v2 statuses and dates. Other references were not all re-opened in v2.1.

entries.finding: Retrieved versioned Neptune documentation describes mean/min-max aggregation and interpolated empty ranges; this is a documentation reference, not a current service recommendation.
Complete compressed CSV assets and sampled built-in charts are explicitly distinguished.
Aligned X is unique/ascending; Y may contain null; arrays are documented with length >=2; numeric step uses time:false.
Public types expose canvas-coordinate gaps, points/filter controls, data updates and range APIs; master is not a pinned package version.
The inspected line-series default has progressive:0 with a disabling comment; this does not cover every ECharts series.
Official axe integration and explicit limits of automated accessibility testing remain documented.
Task Manager OS memory footprint and JavaScript heap are separate measures.
browser.startTracing/stopTracing creates a Chromium trace readable in DevTools, distinct from Playwright tracing.
Worker event loops and draining microtasks before another task support the scheduling distinction; our backpressure design is an inference, not a vendor implementation claim.
